Therefore the filament of bulb A will not be burned out.

raw_record.original_question: 如图所示电路中，A、B是两个完全相同的灯泡，L为自感系数很大的线圈，其直流电阻小于灯泡电阻，C是电容器。闭合开关并待电路稳定后，再断开开关时，A灯灯丝会不会被烧断？

raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, a coil L is connected between the upper left and right two nodes; between the same pair of nodes, a bulb A is connected below, so A and L are in parallel. The left node also connects downward respectively to bulb B and capacitor C to the lower common wire. The right node is connected to the lower common wire through resistor R, the power supply, and the switch; after the switch is opened, the right-side power-supply branch is cut off.

Reasoning: After the switch is closed and the circuit is stable, in the DC steady state capacitor C is equivalent to an open circuit, coil L is equivalent to its DC resistance r_L, and r_L is less than the bulb resistance. A and L are in parallel, and after their currents merge, they pass through B. If B glows normally when stable, then the current I_B in B is the normal operating current of the bulb, and I_B = I_A + I_L, so the steady-state current I_L in the coil is less than I_B.

At the instant the switch is opened, the coil current cannot change abruptly, and the original coil current can only form a local freewheeling loop through A, which is in parallel with it, so the maximum instantaneous current that may appear in A is equal to I_L before opening, and then gradually decays. Since I_L is less than the normal operating current of B, and A and B are completely identical, the current in A will not exceed the normal current of the same type of bulb. Capacitor C is mainly connected with the branch where B is located, and will not additionally superpose on the A-L local loop a current that burns out A.

Therefore the filament of bulb A will not be burned out.
